tools.name: search_duck_content
tools.title: Search DeliciousDuck content
tools.description: Search DeliciousDuck's published recipes, cooking guides, ingredient pages, and calculators. Returns titles, one-line summaries, and canonical URLs.

query.description: What to search for, e.g. 'crispy duck breast skin'.

tools.name: list_duck_content
tools.title: List DeliciousDuck content
tools.description: List everything published on DeliciousDuck — recipes (with slugs), guides, ingredient pages, and live calculators — with canonical URLs.

kind.description: Restrict the listing to one content type.

tools.name: get_duck_recipe
tools.title: Get a DeliciousDuck recipe
tools.description: Get one full DeliciousDuck recipe by slug: ingredients, equipment, step-by-step method, temperature table, troubleshooting, leftovers, and FAQ.

slug.description: Recipe slug, e.g. 'pan-seared-duck-breast'. Use list_duck_content to see slugs.
